meta.name: requesting-code-review
meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在合并前自动检查代码是否满足需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并代码前确保工作符合要求
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify code meets requirements before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your code meets requirements before merging

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你完成任务、实现主要功能或合并代码前，自动派一个代码审查子代理来检查代码问题，并返回审查结果。
howto.when: 当你完成一个子任务、实现主要功能后，或在合并代码到主分支之前，可以请求代码审查。

say.text: 帮我审查刚完成的 Task 2 代码。
say.note: Claude 会派审查子代理检查代码并返回问题列表。

say.text: 在合并前，请求代码审查。
say.note: Claude 会基于当前分支与父分支的差异进行审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically dispatch a code reviewer subagent to check code issues when you complete tasks, implement major features, or before merging, and return review results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you complete a subtask, finish a major feature, or before merging to main branch.

say_en.text: Review the code I just finished for Task 2.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches a reviewer subagent to check and return issues.

say_en.text: Request a code review before merging.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the diff between current and parent branch.
